Jobbeschreibung
Recruiter (m/w/d)
Du bist ehrgeizig, smart und willst nicht jahrelang warten, bis man dir Verantwortung gibt? Dann lies weiter.
Bei den großen Personaldienstleistern lernst du erst monatelang Recruiting, bevor du überhaupt an den Vertrieb darfst. Bei uns nicht. Als Recruiter (m/w/d) übernimmst du von Anfang an den kompletten Zyklus: Du gewinnst Kunden, berätst sie strategisch – und setzt die Recruiting-Projekte anschließend selbst um. Eine Rolle, doppelte Kompetenz, volle Verantwortung für deinen Erfolg.
Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld und helfen Unternehmen, ihre Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken und planbar qualifizierte Talente zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting und strukturiertem Vertrieb. Und wir arbeiten in einem Markt, der durch Fachkräftemangel und demografischen Wandel jedes Jahr weiter wächst.

s.h: Profitiere als Recruiter (m/w/d) von unseren Benefits
s.t:
Attraktives Fixgehalt + ungedeckelte Bonuszahlungen : Deine Leistung entscheidet, was am Monatsende auf deinem Konto landet – nach oben offen.
Unbefristete Festanstellung : Wir bauen langfristig auf dich – Zukunftssicherheit in einer Branche, die durch die Digitalisierung und den Fachkräftemangel stetig wächst.
Echte 360°-Entwicklung : Du baust dir Kompetenz in Vertrieb UND Recruiting auf – das Profil, das im Markt am gefragtesten ist. Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter → Junior Consultant → Senior Consultant.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Coaching : Umfassende Einarbeitung, professionelle Schulungen in Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb sowie regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions
Premium - Arbeitsplatz : Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac) – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Gesundheit im Fokus : Premium-Fitnessvertrag bei einem Studio deiner Wahl.
Top - Versorgung im Office : Faema E61-Siebträgermaschine mit Julius Meinl-Kaffee, hochwertige Tees und flexibles Lunch-System von Meyer Menü
Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe : Kollegiale, leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung – deine Ideen werden gehört und umgesetzt.

Du kontaktierst aktiv potenzielle Neukunden per Telefon und Direktansprache und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
Du präsentierst deine Lösungen überzeugend und begleitest den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.

Nach Vertragsabschluss steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, qualifizierst Kandidaten vor und sorgst für eine professionelle Candidate Experience.

Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielorientiert auf deine KPIs hin.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein.
Das bringst du idealerweise mit
Vertriebsaffinität: Du hast Freude an Akquise und willst aktiv neue Kunden gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video-Call oder persönlich.
Beratungsverständnis: Du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und präsentierst Lösungen strukturiert.
Menschenkenntnis: Du verstehst sowohl die Unternehmens- als auch die Bewerberperspektive.
Eigeninitiative & Leistungswille : Du arbeitest selbstständig, bleibst auch nach einem "Nein" am Ball und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen.
Wichtig : Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit Vertriebserfahrung – uns interessiert nicht dein Lebenslauf, sondern dein Hunger. Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss – das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.
So geht's weiter
1. Bewerben in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, Lebenslauf genügt.
2. Kurzes Kennenlern-Telefonat – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Office in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Nimm deinen Erfolg JETZT selbst in die Hand – wir freuen uns auf dich!

Senior Tech Talent Acquisition Partner

At SumUp, we build simple, affordable financial tools that empower over 4 million small businesses worldwide to get paid, manage their money, and thrive. We are a global team of 3,000+ people across 20+ offices and 90+ nationalities, all dedicated to supporting merchants with excellent products.

As a Talent Acquisition team, we don't just fill seats. We care deeply about hiring excellence and finding people who truly elevate our teams. For us, recruitment is a team sport - we win together, constantly looking at how we can improve and bounce ideas off each other, and always step in to help whenever someone gets stuck or hits a wall.

Our Consumer Tribe - building the SumUp Pay App - is scaling fast and we’re looking for a Senior Tech TA Partner to help the team navigate London’s hyper-competitive market, where top engineers are in high demand.Your superpower will be understanding how to position SumUp's massive scale and impact to passive talent.

Operating as a true talent advisor, you will own hiring across Engineering, Product, Data, and Design (EP&D) for the Consumer portfolio, scaling the technical teams responsible for turning SumUp into a leading financial services platform.

Take a look at our London office

· Lead the full-cycle hiring journey for complex roles across Engineering, Product, Design, and Data for the Consumer tribe, maintaining a consistently high talent bar as we scale.

· Build trusted, embedded relationships with Consumer leadership. You’ll serve as a proactive advisor rather than a reactive coordinator - running regular hiring cadences, maintaining pipeline visibility, and providing market-led recommendations on role prioritization.

· Excel at identifying, engaging, and closing high-caliber passive tech talent in the London market, knowing how to articulate our technical challenges and unique value proposition effectively.

· Track and analyze funnel health metrics across your portfolio to surface blockers, challenge hiring assumptions, optimize sourcing efforts, and provide stakeholders with clear, honest pipeline updates.

· Create an inclusive hiring process that guarantees an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring teams alike, ensuring we stand out in a crowded market.

You'll be great for this role if…

· You have a proven track record of managing full-cycle talent acquisition for complex Engineering, Product, Data, and Design roles within fast-moving tech or fintech environments.

· You possess a deep understanding of the London and broader UK tech landscape, with a knack for mapping talent pools and knowing what it takes to attract and win over high-demand, engineering talent.

· You operate as a trusted business partner rather than just executing briefs - confidently managing multi-stakeholder portfolios, advising hiring managers on market realities, and expertly guiding interview calibration and debriefs.

· You have a data-first mindset, using funnel analytics and recruiting metrics to identify what’s working, track pipeline efficiency, and clearly influence stakeholder decisions.

· You have a genuine care for candidate experience, bringing empathy and transparency to every stage of the hiring journey.

Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. You must have the right to work in the UK to be considered.

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central Covent Garden location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Aroa Biosurgery Limited is a soft-tissue regeneration company that develops, manufactures, and distributes surgical products to improve healing in complex soft tissue reconstruction procedures.

Founded in New Zealand in 2008, the company is built on proprietary AROA ECM™ Technology, a novel extracellular matrix biomaterial derived from ovine forestomach. Aroa’s mission is to “unlock regenerative healing for everybody” by delivering a next generation platform that significantly improve outcomes for patients, surgeons, and clinicians.

This is a 100% remote, part-time opportunity (~20 hours/week) for a Talent Acquisition specialist who knows the US medical device and surgical sales landscape inside out.

The Opportunity We are looking for an expert who doesn't rely on job postings alone, but knows how to hunt, engage, and convert top performing medical sales reps across all US time zones.

As our first dedicated US Talent Acquisition Specialist, you’ll work autonomously as part of our global People & Culture team to build high converting talent pools, coach hiring managers, and drive direct hiring efforts.

With a focus on sales, but with a number of other roles to keep things interesting, this is a chance to shape the future of recruitment for our US business, while collaborating as part of a global team.

While this role will primarily focus on recruiting Territory Sales Managers, you'll also support recruitment across a range of other functions, offering plenty of variety while helping shape the future of recruitment for our U.S. business as part of a global team. What You’ll Do
Targeted Passive Sourcing: Proactively map and engage top tier commercial sales talent across the US.
End-to-End Campaign Management: Manage screening, interview coordination and offer negotiations alongside P&C Business Partners.
Hiring Manager Upskilling: Coach US hiring leaders on structured selection, competency evaluation, and mitigating hiring bias
Process & Analytics: Track pipeline health and manage recruitment tech tools (BambooHR, Xref).

Previous recruitment experience with a strong, proven background in Medical Device, Surgical Sales, or Life Sciences hiring.
Deep familiarity with US commercial sales compensation structures, talent dynamics, and sales candidate motivations.
Exceptional passive sourcing capability using LinkedIn Recruiter and industry networks.
Demonstrated ability to manage recruitment campaigns autonomously across multiple time zones.
Adaptable, proactive mindset with a strong sense of humor and collaborative spirit.
Why Choose This Role?
True Flexibility: High-impact fractional leadership (~20 hours/week) with complete remote autonomy.
Quality Over Quantity: Focus on strategic, targeted hires rather than high-volume transaction processing.
Meaningful Product: Represent medical technology that restores bodies and changes patient outcomes globally.

Building the Future of Open Finance
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

Our Global Sourcing team is looking for an exceptional Sourcer to help build the future of global finance at Payward. This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard.
Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market:
Managing uncertainty : Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record
Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly
Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap.
Builder mentality : We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge
Team work : Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition
In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below.
The opportunity
Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies
Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends
Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods
Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement
Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.)
Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market
Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring

Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org
High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing
High motor
Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities
Strong product sense
Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics
High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise.
Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting
Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required.

You’ll start by doing what you do best: closing elite technical roles and building deep client relationships.
But this isn’t a traditional recruiting role. As you deliver hiring outcomes, you’ll also learn how to integrate AI into every part of the recruiting workflow—and help clients do the same as our platform launches.
Hop works with Fortune 500 companies and top VC-backed startups , specializing in GenAI, ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Product talent.
We're pre-launch on Moon Engine , an agent-orchestrated recruiting ops system where autonomous agents act as decision partners, coordinating hiring with governance and auditability.
At Hop , you're a player-coach in the truest sense : hands-on recruiter today, AI-enabled recruiting advisor tomorrow. You'll work directly with our engineering and product teams to test Moon Engine, provide critical feedback, and master the future of recruiting—then bring that expertise to Fortune 500 companies and top startups as we onboard them to the platform.
Think of it as dual-track growth : deepen your recruiting craft while becoming an expert in AI-orchestrated hiring workflows.
🧬 What Makes This Different
You're not choosing between recruiting or AI. You're mastering both.
Hands-on recruiting excellence: You'll lead complex searches for senior technical talent—building relationships, managing clients, closing candidates. This is real, high-stakes recruiting work.
Learn AI integration deeply: As you recruit, you'll progressively learn to leverage Moon Engine's capabilities—from AI-assisted sourcing to automated screening. You'll become fluent in how AI amplifies (not replaces) recruiter judgment.
Product development partner: Work directly with our engineering and product teams. Your real-world recruiting experiences become product requirements. Your feedback shapes what gets built.
Customer onboarding expert: As Moon Engine launches, you'll help enterprise clients transition to AI-enabled hiring. You'll teach them what you've learned—making you indispensable to both Hop and our clients.
What You'll Actually Do
Phase 1: High-Level Recruiting Execution (Day 1 Onwards)
Lead full-cycle searches for senior technical roles: Staff+ Engineers, ML Scientists, Data Platform Leaders, Technical Product Managers
Build and maintain client relationships: Partner directly with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders—becoming their trusted hiring advisor
Manage candidate relationships: Source, engage, interview, close top-tier technical talent with white-glove service
Run strategic intake sessions: Translate business needs and technical requirements into precise hiring strategies
Deliver results: Own outcomes, timelines, and client satisfaction for complex, high-impact searches
Phase 2: AI Integration & Learning (Progressive Ramp)
Test Moon Engine in production: Use the platform daily on your real searches—provide honest feedback on what works and what doesn't
Learn AI-assisted workflows: Gradually adopt AI-powered sourcing, scoring, screening, and matching as features become available
Partner with engineering/product: Participate in feedback sessions, feature demos, and roadmap discussions. Your recruiting insights drive product decisions.
Document best practices: As you learn what AI does well (and where human judgment is critical), you'll help create the playbook for AI-enabled recruiting
Become the expert: Over 6-12 months, you'll develop deep expertise in how to orchestrate human + AI recruiting workflows
Phase 3: Client Enablement & Thought Leadership (As Moon Engine Launches)
Onboard enterprise clients: Guide new customers through adopting Moon Engine—teaching them what you've learned
Lead training sessions: Show clients how to integrate AI into their hiring processes effectively
Strategic consulting: Advise companies on restructuring their recruiting operations for an AI-first world
Represent Hop externally: Share insights at events, on podcasts, in content—establishing yourself as a recruiting + AI expert
🎯 Who Thrives Here
Must-Haves
5+ years recruiting technical talent with a track record of closing senior/leadership roles (ML Engineers, Staff+ Engineers, Data Platform leads, etc.)
Exceptional client relationship skills: You can advise executives, push back when needed, and build long-term trusted partnerships
Candidate relationship mastery: You know how to attract, engage, and close passive candidates at the highest levels
Recruiting fundamentals are second nature: Sourcing, intake, interviewing, offer negotiation, stakeholder management—you've done it all at a high level
Genuinely curious about AI: You don't need to be technical, but you're excited to learn how AI can augment your recruiting work
Growth mindset: You're willing to learn new tools, experiment with new workflows, and occasionally feel uncomfortable as you master something new

Prior experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, AI sourcing platforms) in your recruiting work
Background at high-growth tech companies, recruiting agencies, or technical recruiting teams
You've already experimented with automation, built recruiting processes, or created "hacks" to work more efficiently
Comfortable giving product feedback or working closely with technical teams
Cultural Fit
Execution-oriented: You deliver results, not excuses
Collaborative learner: You'll work closely with engineers and product people—ego can't get in the way
Comfortable with ambiguity: Moon Engine is pre-launch. Things will change. You adapt.
Naturally curious: You want to understand how things work , not just use them
Long-term thinker: You see this as a multi-year journey to become a recruiting + AI expert, not just a job
🌙 Why This Opportunity Matters
Most recruiters will eventually have to learn AI. You'll be years ahead.
You're not choosing between being a great recruiter or learning AI—you're mastering both while helping build the platform. Think of it like learning digital marketing in 2005. Early movers win.

About Tailscale
Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more.

We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

We’re hiring multiple experienced Talent Acquisition Partners to join Tailscale on an initial 6-month contract basis, with the potential to extend and/or convert to full-time roles based on business needs and performance.
These roles will support different parts of the organization, with individual assignments focused on Engineering, Product & Design (EPD), Go-to-Market & G&A, or a broader cross-functional portfolio spanning multiple organizations . During the application process, candidates will have the opportunity to indicate where they have the most experience and where they would prefer to focus.
You’ll operate as a fully integrated member of our Talent Acquisition team, owning searches from intake through offer and partnering with hiring managers and business leaders to develop thoughtful recruiting strategies, navigate competitive talent markets, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience.
Tailscale operates in a highly technical, fast-moving environment, so we’re looking for recruiters who are curious, adaptable, and comfortable learning new areas quickly. Whether your background is primarily technical, commercial/corporate, or broad-based, you’ll bring strong recruiting craft, market intelligence, data, and sound judgment to help hiring teams make great decisions while maintaining a consistently high hiring bar.

Lead Full-Cycle Recruiting
Own complex searches from intake through offer across EPD, GTM, G&A, or a combination of functions based on assigned business needs.
Partner with hiring managers to define candidate profiles, develop recruiting strategies, and establish effective interview processes.
Manage multiple searches while maintaining a high bar for quality, speed, and candidate experience.
Lead candidate assessment, offer strategy, negotiation, and closing in partnership with hiring teams.
Develop Talent & Sourcing Strategies
Build recruiting and sourcing strategies based on business priorities, role requirements, talent availability, and market conditions.
Partner with Sourcers on targeted searches and talent mapping while sourcing directly as needed and maintaining accountability for pipeline health.
Use recruiting data, candidate feedback, and market intelligence to evaluate search performance and adjust strategies.
Identify alternative talent pools, companies, locations, or profiles when searches require a different approach.
Advise & Influence Hiring Teams
Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders and serve as a consultative recruiting partner.
Provide actionable insights on talent markets, candidate expectations, hiring timelines, and potential tradeoffs.
Constructively challenge assumptions and create accountability around interview quality, timely feedback, decision-making, and candidate experience.
Proactively identify hiring risks and partner with TA leadership when broader support or escalation is needed.
Recruit Across Your Area of Focus
